body:
## Pensieve 0.5.4

### Fixed
- **Email on the phone:** attachments and the original layout of an email opened only through the computer — "Not connected to the Pensieve server" even though the phone fetches mail by itself. They now open on the phone, also for mail the computer fetched.
- **Mail you were only CC'd on** was treated as work for you. The AI now knows who an email was sent to: CC'd mail is for information unless it asks you yourself. Open mail it had already marked as a task is checked again.
- **Desktop pet:** it couldn't be dragged into the top part of the screen (on a Mac; on Linux with Wayland it couldn't be moved at all). It now goes anywhere, and its speech bubble opens below it near the top.
- **Pages:** new and imported pages no longer pile up at the bottom; the list is newest first.

### New
- **Who an email is for:** From, To and CC on every opened email, "you" marked, and a "CC'd to you" tag in the list.
- **"Plain text" and "Original layout"** replace "Text / As sent" (the original layout is the email as the sender formatted it, with pictures and tables).
- **Sort your pages:** newest or oldest first, last edited, name A→Z or Z→A, or your own order (drag to arrange).
- **Pin pages** to the top of the list (on every device), and **find a page by name**.
- **Imported pages keep their dates** from Notion (and from Obsidian notes), so sorting by time matches Notion.

### Download

| Your system | File |
|---|---|
| Windows 10 / 11 | **Pensieve-Setup-0.5.4.exe** |
| Mac with Apple Silicon | **Pensieve-0.5.4-mac-arm64.zip** |
| Mac with Intel | **Pensieve-0.5.4-mac-x64.zip** |
| Linux (64-bit) | **Pensieve-0.5.4-linux-x86_64.AppImage** or **Pensieve-0.5.4-linux-amd64.deb** |
| Android 8+ (HarmonyOS via 卓易通) | **Pensieve-0.5.4-android.apk** |
| iPhone / iPad (iOS 15+) | **Pensieve-0.5.4-ios-unsigned.ipa** — install with Sideloadly or AltStore ([how](https://photonghost308.github.io/pensieve-app/#ios-install)) |

Already using Pensieve? It updates itself (Settings → General → Updates). Your notes stay as they are.
